mods.name: LC FTB Hook
mods.description: Paid claims, upkeep, protection regions and wars for FTB Chunks or Open Parties and Claims - paid with Lightman's Currency or Create: Numismatics. Needs one claim mod and one currency mod.

releases.notes:
## [4.5.4]

### Fixed
- With FTB Chunks, two protection checks ignored the region settings and always treated them as Public, so they never protected anything:
  - FTB Chunks 2101.1.24's new nether portal protection (world setting `nether_portal_creation`): a player travelling through a nether portal still got a portal built inside another team's protected region. It now follows the block edit setting of the chunk the portal would be built in.
  - Item frames, boats and minecarts in a protected region could be broken by another player's arrows and other projectiles. The non-living entity protection now covers those too.

### Changed
- With FTB Chunks, a few protections now follow the region instead of always protecting every claim for free (FTB Chunks read them from its own team setting, which is always on, no matter what the region has):
  - Pistons pushing or pulling blocks into another team's claim (FTB Chunks' `piston_protection`, on by default), fire spreading into it (`fire_spread_protection`) and fluids flowing into it (`flowing_fluid_protection`) are only blocked where the claim's region protects block edits. A region with Public block edits, or a private chunk opened to Public, lets them in.
  - Explosions only break item frames, boats and minecarts where the region has no explosion protection, the same as blocks.

  Server team claims keep FTB Chunks' own settings.

### Added
- If FTB Chunks or another mod checks one of the region protection settings without saying which chunk it is about, the server log names that caller once. Region settings can't apply there (the setting counts as Public), so this makes such a gap visible.

### Compatibility
- Tested against FTB Chunks 2101.1.24, FTB Teams 2101.1.12, FTB Library 2101.1.39, Architectury 13.0.12, FTB Chunks x Xaero's Map Compat 1.4.0 and NeoForge 21.1.266 (older supported versions keep working: the minimum versions stay FTB Chunks 2101.1.22, FTB Teams 2101.1.11, FTB Library 2101.1.35 and NeoForge 21.1.197). The startup note about a differing FTB Chunks version now compares against 2101.1.24.

releases.notes:
## [4.5.3]

### Added
- Upkeep discount for large chunk amounts (server setting `upkeepDeceleration`, off by default). When on, protection upkeep grows logarithmically instead of linearly with the number of chunks. Each protection setting is counted over all of a team's billable chunks it is active on, no matter how they are split into regions, and that count `n` is billed as `n` up to `upkeepDecelerationThreshold` (default 64) and as `T + f*(n-T) + (1-f) * s * ln(1 + (n-T)/s)` above it (`upkeepDecelerationScale` s, default 128; `upkeepDecelerationFloor` f, default 0). With the defaults, a setting on 200 chunks costs about 22% less, on 500 about 49% less, on 1000 about 67% less. Every extra chunk still costs something, so a larger claim never pays less in total; splitting land into regions changes nothing; and a team never pays more than without the discount. Force-load upkeep is not affected. All four settings can be changed with `/lc_ftb_hook config set`, and the region screens update right away.
- The Region List's upkeep breakdown and `/lc_ftb_hook upkeep_details` show the discount as its own line, "Upkeep discount for large chunk amounts". The regions themselves keep showing their list prices.
- `/lc_ftb_hook upkeep_discount` explains the discount: how it is calculated, the server's current numbers with examples, and, for the player's own team, each protection setting's chunk count, what it is billed as, and the discount per upkeep.

releases.notes:
## [4.5.2]

### Fixed
- ScorchedGuns could damage claimed land no matter which protections a region had, because it changes blocks directly instead of through the events claim mods watch. Covered now, with FTB Chunks and Open Parties and Claims alike:
  - Bullets shooting out glass, panes, ice, lanterns and other fragile blocks
  - Heavy rounds (Krahg, Osborne slug) destroying stone, wood and other blocks
  - Beam weapons (CR4K Mining Laser, Flayed God, Shard Culler) mining blocks from a distance
  - Bullets priming TNT and powder/nitro kegs, and shooting doors open
  - Fire rounds, incendiary grenades and Hellfire bombs setting fire
  - Scamp Tanks and Scamp rockets crushing barrels, lanterns, granite, sandbags and supply crates
  - The Penetrator block drilling its tunnel into a claim

  Each case follows the protection that fits whoever caused it. If a player fired the shot, the block edit rules apply to that player (for doors, the interact rules), so team members can still shoot out their own glass. If a mob fired it, mob griefing protection applies. Anything without a player or mob behind it, such as the Penetrator, follows explosion protection, the same as TNT. Gun explosions (grenades, rockets) were already covered by explosion protection. Nothing changes when ScorchedGuns isn't installed.
- With FTB Chunks, mob griefing protection only ever stopped endermen, because FTB Chunks only applies it to mobs listed in its `ftbchunks:entity_mob_griefing_blacklist` tag. This mod now adds ravagers, zombies (including husks, drowned and zombie villagers), vindicators, evokers, the Wither and silverfish to that tag. Protected regions and server-team claims are now actually safe from crop trampling, door breaking and the other griefing the protection describes. Like everything else in FTB Chunks' mob griefing check, it applies while the mob itself stands in the protected chunk.

releases.notes:
## [4.5.1]

### Changed
- Free chunks (`freeChunks`) are now only free to claim - they pay protection upkeep like every other chunk. So far the first `freeChunks` chunks of a team were also left out of protection upkeep, which made e.g. a protection on a 20-chunk region with 5 free chunks bill only 15. Server owners who want the old behavior back can set the new server setting `freeChunksExemptFromUpkeep` to `true` (also with `/lc_ftb_hook config set`). Force-load upkeep is not affected either way.
- Changing `freeChunks` or `freeChunksExemptFromUpkeep` with `/lc_ftb_hook config set` now updates the upkeep shown in the region screens right away instead of on the next refresh.

releases.notes:
## [4.5.0]

### Added
- Force-load mode per region. In a region's settings, the team picks when that region's force-loaded chunks are kept loaded - and they're charged exactly then:
  - **Team online**: only while someone from the team is online (what force-loads did by default so far).
  - **Anyone online**: while at least one player is online anywhere on the server.
  - **Always**: always loaded and charged every upkeep period, also while nobody is on the server.
  The change takes effect immediately. A region's force-loads are charged for every upkeep period in which they were loaded at any point, so switching to a cheaper mode or logging out just before the upkeep runs doesn't make them free.
- This mod now decides when force-loaded chunks are loaded, not the claim mod: FTB Chunks' `force_load_mode` / offline force-loading and Open Parties and Claims' offline force-loading are ignored while this mod charges the upkeep. Which chunks are force-loaded, the limits and the claim screens stay with the claim mod.
- New server settings `forceLoadModeAlwaysEnabled`, `forceLoadModeAnyPlayerEnabled` and `forceLoadModeTeamOnlineEnabled` (all `true` by default, also changeable with `/lc_ftb_hook config set`) choose which modes teams can pick; a disabled mode isn't offered. A region whose mode gets disabled falls back to the next cheaper allowed mode (Always → Anyone online → Team online), so nobody pays more than they chose; if there is none, its force-loads are switched off (not loaded, not charged) until the team picks an allowed mode. New force-loads can't be requested in such a region.

### Changed
- The server-wide `forceLoadUpkeepMode` setting is replaced by the per-region mode. On the first start after the update, every existing region takes over what it said (`ALWAYS` → Always, `DEFAULT` → Team online), so nothing changes on the update itself. The setting has no effect after that.
- Team online: force-loads used to be charged only if a team member happened to be online at the very moment the upkeep ran. Now they're charged for every period in which a team member was online (and the chunks were loaded) at some point. Teams that log out just before the upkeep runs pay a little more often than before.

### Fixes
- Force-loads on Always and `protectionUpkeepMode=HEAVY` now really charge while nobody is online (GitHub issue #7, reported by deveyus). Upkeep stopped completely while the server was empty, so these charged nothing overnight even though they are meant to charge regardless of who is online. Upkeep now keeps running on an empty server whenever something is charged then (and, if a team can't pay, its force-loads and protections are dismantled around the clock); teams with nothing charged while empty are left alone until players are back, exactly as before. Team messages about this only reach members who are online; anything that happened while everyone was offline shows up in the upkeep overview. `/lc_ftb_hook force_upkeep` now also works on an empty server in that case.
- FTB Chunks: parties paid their upkeep several times per period - once for the party itself and once more for every member. With FTB Teams, a member's personal team reports the party as its team, so the party showed up in the upkeep pass once per member as well; a one-member party paid double, a three-member party four times. Each team is now settled exactly once per period, whatever the claim mod lists, and a member's leftover personal team no longer counts as an active solo team. Solo players and Open Parties and Claims were not affected. The extra payments went to the server account; affected parties can be refunded from it (each upkeep payment shows up there once per charge, labelled with the team name).
